newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on institutional buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher on mainly buying by institutional investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 7.4 points or 0.64 percent up at 1,148.05 on a turnover of 40 million taka. Of 127 traded issues 79 gained, 42 lost, and six unchanged.

"Small investors kept mostly on the sidelines and were watching the market," said one broker. Bangladesh Lamps gained 27 taka to 4,620, Beximco Pharmaceuticals lost 0.54 to 138.73 and Apex Tannery fell 5.46 to 659.99.
